clueVerdicts.explanation: The July 2008 opening, Baltic harbor location, North Sea and Baltic Sea displays, and relationship to the German Oceanographic Museum identify Ozeaneum in Stralsund.

The 1913 establishment within the zoological-garden complex, three-storey layout, more than 9,000 animals, 250 fish tanks, crocodilians, tuataras, jellyfish, and coral basins directly identify Aquarium Berlin.
The underground aquarium beneath the Trocadéro gardens, its origin in the palace complex, 1937 renovation, and 2006 reopening identify Aquarium de Paris.
The 1991 opening and the unusually broad sea-related exhibition scope identify Nausicaá, the French National Sea Centre in Boulogne-sur-Mer.
The municipal founding, 5 June 1999 opening, Atlantic-fed exterior pools, and 4.4-million-litre Captain Nemo observation pool identify Aquarium Finisterrae in A Coruña.
